 Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus confirms this correspondence, showing an extensive, near-verbatim overlap spanning segments §0.3–14.4 with 0.99 similarity [DharmaNexus]. Substantial portions of the poem are also shared with the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, both parts), which preserves thousands of matching characters, including the entirety of segments §0.3–14.4 [DharmaNexus].

In addition to its commentary and twin apadāna parallel, the poem shares formulaic verses with various other Therāpadāna compositions, such as the *Jatukaṇṇittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 411), *Saparivārachattadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 332), *Mahākoṭṭhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 539), and *Upavānattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 562) [DharmaNexus].
